dedupIdentity.value: exact cmd_id string; volatile RAM LRU; not device/key-generation scoped

dedupClockGate.value: expiry sweep requires completed SNTP; reboot/deinit loses cache

dryRunOrder.value: dry_run precedes confirm and dedup/security verification

responseSigning.noKey: plaintext response is allowed when no command key exists

responseTopicValidator.deviceBinding: not proven by validator; broker ACL/server binding required

serverPolicyRequired: Server deduplication is durable/server-owned; firmware cache is only a volatile 128-entry id-only safety net.

Server models dry_run as a separate non-mutating operation because firmware evaluates it before confirm and dedup.
Server must not claim every response is signed; firmware emits plaintext when no command key exists.
